paite: Huan Pathian in huchi a chi in hiai thute tengteng agen hi.
heading: Thupiak Sawm / (Diu 5.1-21)

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, Aigupta gam a kipan leh saltanna inn a pan hon pikhepa ka hi;
ka ma ah keimah lou ngal pathian dangte na nei ding ahi kei.
Milim gelhthoh himhim ahihkeileh tunglam van a om thil lim kibatpih mawngmawng hiam nuai lei a om hiam lei nuai a tui sung a om kibatpih na kibawl ding ahi kei.

Akiang uah na kun ding ahi kei, a-nna uh leng na sem ding ahi kei. Kei lah TOUPA na Pathian, mullit hat Pathian, kei hon hote khang thumna leh khang lina tan a, pate gitlouhna tate tung a thuk ka hi ngal a,
kei hon it a, ka thupiakte zuite lak a sang tampite kiang a zahngaihna lak zelpa ka hi.
TOUPA na Pathian min na mawk gen ding ahi kei; amin mawk genmi lah TOUPA'N moh lou in akoih ngal kei a.
Sabbath ni siangthou a tan ding theigige in.
Ni guk sung teng nna na sem ding a, na nna tengteng nasep ding ahi.

Himahleh ani sagihna TOUPA na Pathian Sabbath ni ahi. Huai ah nna himhim; nang leng, na tapa in leng, na tanu in leng, na sikhapa hiam, na sikhanu hiam, na ganta hiam, na huangsung a om na mikhual hiam in leng asem ding ahi kei.
Ani guk ni in TOUPA'N lei leh van, tuipi leh asung ua om tengteng bawl in, ani sagih ni in akhawl ngal a. Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Sabbath ni vualzawl in, atang siangthou hi.
Na nu leh na pa zahtak in. TOUPA na Pathian in ahon piak gam a na nite asautheihna ding in.
Tual na that ding ahi kei.
Ang na kawm ding ahi kei.
Na gu ding ahi kei.
Na inveng siatna ding in palai taklou na hi ding ahi kei.
Na inveng inn na eng ding ahi kei. Na inveng zi na eng ding ahi kei, asikhapa leng, asikhanu leng, abawngtal hiam, asabiltung hiam, thil himhim na inveng a peuhpeuh.
Mi tengteng in vanpigingte, khophiate, pengkul husate leh tang kang khu amu ua; mite'n huaite amuh un, akisuan ua, gamlapi ah adingh uhi.
heading: Mite Lauhna / (Diu 5.22-33)

paite: Mosi kiang ah, "Ka kiang uah thu gen inla, ka hon ngaikhe ding uhi. Himahleh Pathian in hon houpih kei hen, ka si kha ding uh," achi uhi.
Mosi in akiang uah, "Lau kei un. Amah launa na ma ua a-om a, na khelhlouhna ding un, noute hon enchian ding a Pathian hong pai ahih ziak in," achi hi.
Mite gamlatak ah adingh ua, Pathian omna mun mial bikbek lam ah Mosi ava pai nai hi.
TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, Israel kiang ah hichibang in na chi ding, "Van a pan nou ka hon houpih na muta uhi.
heading: Maitam Toh Kisai Dan

paite: Kei lou dangka pathiante na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Dangka-eng pathiante leng na kibawl ding uh ahi kei.

Kei a ding in lei maitam na bawl ding ua, huai ah na halmang thillatte leh na lemna thillatte, na belamte leh na bawngtalte na lan ding uh ahi. Mun tengteng a ka min ka khumna ah na kiang uah ka hong dia, ka hon vualzawl ding hi.
Suang maitam na hon bawlsakleh, suangsek a na bawl louh ding ahi. Suang tung a na vanzat na likleh, na hihnin ahi ngal a.
Huai a na vuaktanna adawklouhna ding in, ka maitam ah kalbi in na kahtou ding ahi kei," achi hi.
